Our Core Specialisms

Building Work for Walsall Homes & Businesses

Extensions, conversions, refurbishments, renovations and disabled adaptations across Walsall and the West Midlands.

Extensions

Home & Commercial Extensions

Single and double storey extensions built to your plans or ours, from groundworks and brickwork through to roof cover and final finish.

  • Full structural groundwork and brickwork
  • Roof lanterns, bi-folds and glazing
  • Building Regulations sign-off
Conversions

Loft & Garage Conversions

Turning unused loft and garage space into genuinely usable rooms, with structural calculations, insulation and certification handled properly.

  • Structural steel and floor joist installs
  • Insulation, plaster and full decoration
  • Certified building control completion
Refurbishments

Refurbishments & Renovations

Complete property refurbishment for landlords, homeowners and commercial premises, maintaining trades across joinery, plumbing and electrical.

  • Strip out and full first fix
  • Kitchens, bathrooms and joinery
  • Snagging and handover walk through
How We Work

The Four Step Build Process

From first survey to final handover, every stage is planned and signed off.

01

Site Survey

On site assessment of the property, access and scope, with a free no obligation quotation.

02

Fixed Scope

Drawings, structural calculations where required, and itemised pricing agreed before work starts.

03

Build Phase

Qualified trades across groundworks, brickwork, roofing, joinery, plumbing and electrics.

04

Handover

Snagging, building control completion and a clean handover of the finished project.
